    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Event_GapFindingsReceived" targetRef="Task_MakeCorrections"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_MakeCorrections" targetRef="Task_RequestFinalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_RequestFinalAudit" targetRef="Event_FinalResultReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Event_FinalResultReceived" targetRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotMet" name="Criteria not met" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="Event_CertificationNotAwarded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_AwardCertification" targetRef="Task_IssueDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_IssueDocuments" targetRef="Event_CertificationIssued"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPrepareDocumentation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToGatherEvidence</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToSelfAssessment</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDocumentation" name="Prepare documentation">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepareDocumentationDone</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEvidence" name="Gather evidence">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToGatherEvidence" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_GatherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSelfAssessment" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_SelfAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareDocumentationDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatherEvidenceDone" sourceRef="Task_GatherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfAssessmentDone" sourceRef="Task_SelfAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToReviewProcesses" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepJoin" targetRef="Task_ReviewProcesses"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalAuditToGateway" sourceRef="Task_FinalAudit" targetRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotMet" name="Criteria not met" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="Event_CertificationNotAwarded"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEvidence" name="Gather evidence">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToGatherEvidence</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GatherEvidenceDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelfAssessment" name="Conduct self-assessment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToSelfAssessment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelfAssessmentDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepJoin" name="Preparation completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepareDocumentationDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GatherEvidenceDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelfAssessmentDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToReviewProcesses</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewProcesses" name="Review company processes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToReviewProcesses</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToIdentify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyGaps" name="Identify gaps and issues">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToIdentify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IdentifyToCorrections</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeCorrections" name="Make corrections and improvements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IdentifyToCorrections</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CorrectionsToFinalAudit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalAudit" name="Conduct final audit">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CorrectionsToFinalAudit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalAuditToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CriteriaMet" name="All criteria met?" default="Flow_NotMet">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalAuditToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Met</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotMet</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwardCertification" name="Award certification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Met</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AwardToIssue</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueDocuments" name="Issue official documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AwardToIssue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IssueToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_DocumentsIssued" name="Official documents issued">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IssueToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_CertificationNotAwarded" name="Certification not awarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotMet</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="Event_ProcessStart" targetRef="Task_ScheduleAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ScheduledToPrepSplit" sourceRef="Task_ScheduleAudit" targetRef="Gateway_PrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPrepareDocumentation" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToGatherEvidence" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_GatherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSelfAssessment" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_SelfAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareDocumentationDone" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatherEvidenceDone" sourceRef="Task_GatherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfAssessmentDone" sourceRef="Task_SelfAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToReviewProcesses" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepJoin" targetRef="Task_ReviewProcesses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToIdentify" sourceRef="Task_ReviewProcesses" targetRef="Task_IdentifyGaps"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentifyToCorrections" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyGaps" targetRef="Task_MakeCorrections"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CorrectionsToFinalAudit" sourceRef="Task_MakeCorrections" targetRef="Task_FinalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalAuditToGateway" sourceRef="Task_FinalAudit" targetRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Met" name="All criteria met" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="Task_AwardCertification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allCriteriaMet == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotMet" name="Criteria not met" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="Event_CertificationNotAwarded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AwardToIssue" sourceRef="Task_AwardCertification" targetRef="Task_IssueDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssueToEnd" sourceRef="Task_IssueDocuments" targetRef="Event_DocumentsIssued"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
